messages:
lina: Heads up - ran into a confusing onboarding issue in the sampleapp when a customer has two orgs. SDK picked the wrong project by default.

samir: Oof. Which project did it land on?

lina: It picked `redwood-prod` from a global env var even though the API key is org-scoped for `acme-corp`. Shoulde bound to `acme-prod`.

maria: Do you have REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT set locally? We added a fallback a while ago for backcompat.

lina: Yup. Repro steps: 
```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=org_acme_XXXX
export REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT=redwood-prod
node sampleapp/start.js
```
App ends up using REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT instead of the key-bound project.

samir: That sounds like a regression from 0.9.2. We intentionally made key scope override env var so people don't accidentally operate across orgs.

ajay: My mental precedence list: 1) explicit project param to Client 2) project bound to API key 3) REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT 4) interactive prompt. Is that what we want?

maria: Yep. Also CLI currently behaves differently (CLI: env var > key-bound). That inconsistency hurts onboarding.

lina: Customer hit this because their CI images set REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT globally. They unknowingly routed workload to a different org project.

samir: Root cause looks like an auth-introspect fallback bug. If the token-introspect call fails we silently fall back to env var, instead of using the cached or known key scope. Should either surface an error or prefer the key-binding when possible.

ajay: Can you paste the SDK snippet where introspect is used? Maybe a one-line fix.

lina: Current node sdk snippet: 
```js
let project = process.env.REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT || await introspectKey(apiKey).project;
```

maria: Yep thatxplains it - order is reversed. Should be: 
```js
let project = (await introspectKey(apiKey))?.project || process.env.REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT;
```

samir: + also add a warning log and telemetry when we fall back to env var while the key is scoped: `warn: using REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT while key-scoped project exists`. That will surface to customers and help debugging.

ajay: Also align CLI to same precedence. Add a unit test for env var vs key-bound precedence and an integration test for the introspect failure path.

lina: I'll open a tiny PR: fix ordering, add warning, tests. Target 0.9.3 patch. Label `devex/priority`.

devx-bot: PR created - #4583 by lina - "fix(auth): prefer key-bound project over REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT". CI queued.

maria: Quick UX ask - can we add a short note in sampleapp README and the SDK auth docs about env var naming? Many infra images use `DEFAULT_PROJECT` generically. Proposed note: "SDK precedence: explicit project param > key-bound project > REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT > interactive prompt."

lina: Will add README snippet and SDK docs blurb in the PR.

samir: Also consider the rotation case: if an API key rotates and now belongs to a different org/project we should fail fast rather than silently switching. Suggest a soft error: AuthScopeMismatch with a helper to set explicit project or rebind.

ajay: Agree. Soft error plus a helper will reduce surprise. Also add a changelog entry for the precedence change so operators know.

maria: Nice catch. Small code change but big customer impact.

lina: PR merged after CI passed. Shipping in 0.9.3. I added the README note and unit/integration tests.

devx-bot: CI passed for #4583 - all tests green :tada:
